lidar.forward_angle_method: hand ~30 cm in front of the robot, held vs removed (hand cluster 349..18 deg, center 4.2, nearest 1.8 deg at 315 mm); cluttered desk
lidar.angle_direction_note: Slamtec convention (angle increases clockwise seen from above). Left-side hand check did not register; verify (Phase 4) before relying on left/right.
lidar.range_note: No measured reference: the 1000 mm object was never detected (moving clutter 30-45 cm from the LiDAR). Offset stays 0 until 1000 mm and ~300 mm agree.

camera.note: Wide-angle lens with visible barrel distortion. Measure with objects at the left/right image edges, robot on the floor in a clear area. Placeholder is NOT measured.

chassis.min_duty_note: Front-left (M1) alone: hummed at duty 30, turned at 35 (battery 6.4-7.2 V, wheels up, 2026-11-07). Non-zero wheel commands map into min_duty..duty_cap.
